label: conj:wenzl-positivity-implies-substrate-positivity
title: Wenzl positivity at $q_0$ implies substrate $C^*$-Frobenius positivity
html:
The companion conjecture conj:os-reflection-positivity-from-reeb reduces the Wightman-axiom portion of the Yang–Mills millennium statement to a single substrate axiom: C^*-Frobenius positivity of the QOU Frobenius–Hopf substrate at q = q_0. This conjecture takes the natural next step. The axiom should be derivable from Wenzl's positivity criterion for \mathrm{Rep}(U_q(\mathfrak{sl}_2)) at q_0 \in \mathbb{R}_{>1}, as a consequence of existing unitarity.

Conjecture (Wenzl positivity at q_0 implies substrate C^*-Frobenius positivity). Wenzl's positivity criterion for the representation category \mathrm{Rep}(U_q(\mathfrak{sl}_2)) at q = q_0 \in \mathbb{R}_{>1} — the criterion that picks out unitary fusion categories among the q-deformed semisimple ones — implies the substrate C^*-Frobenius positivity axiom of conj:os-reflection-positivity-from-reeb. Equivalently, the Müger C^*-norm on the Frobenius–Hopf substrate A at q_0, induced by the categorical trace of \mathrm{Rep}(U_q(\mathfrak{sl}_2)), makes the antipode-twisted Frobenius pairing \langle\theta(\cdot), \cdot\rangle_F positive-definite on the positive-time Reeb half.

Here \theta is the Reeb reflection (the antipodal \mathbb{Z}_2 \subset U(1) of conj:os-reflection-positivity-from-reeb) and \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_F the Frobenius form of A.

The natural follow-up

The OS-reflection-positivity conjecture conj:os-reflection-positivity-from-reeb leaves the substrate C^*-Frobenius positivity axiom as the sole genuinely new input. That axiom has three free parameters:

  1. Choice of C^*-norm on A at q_0. The substrate algebra A at q_0 \in \mathbb{R}_{>1} admits several candidate C^*-completions:
    • the universal C^*-norm of A as a *-algebra;
    • the GNS norm with respect to the Frobenius pairing;
    • the Müger norm built from the categorical trace of the ambient tensor category.
  2. Positivity of the antipode-twisted pairing in the chosen norm.
  3. Compatibility with the antipode S.

The Müger norm has properties (2) and (3) by construction for any unitary C^*-tensor category \mathbf{C} in the BKLR sense (Müger 2003, Bischoff–Kawahigashi–Longo–Rehren). The only open question is therefore whether \mathrm{Rep}(U_q(\mathfrak{sl}_2)) at q_0 \in \mathbb{R}_{>1} is unitary as a C^*-tensor category. That is exactly the content of Wenzl's positivity criterion.

Wenzl's criterion (recall)

Wenzl proved ([wenzl1988], [wenzl1990], with the \mathrm{SU}(N) generalisation by Wenzl and the \mathfrak{sl}_n-equivariant version by Kazhdan–Wenzl [kazhdanwenzl1993]): the representation category \mathrm{Rep}(U_q(\mathfrak{sl}_2)) admits a unitary structure (positive C^*-trace + positive inner product on each Hom space) iff q lies in either:

  • \{q = e^{i\pi / N} : N \geq 3\} (the roots-of-unity range yielding the modular tensor categories at level N - 2); or
  • \{q \in \mathbb{R}_{>0}\} (the real positive range, in particular q_0 \approx 1.10998).

The criterion is sharp: outside these two regions, the categorical trace fails to be positive, and no C^*-completion of the underlying algebra makes \mathrm{Rep} a C^*-tensor category.

The QOU substrate parameter q_0 \approx 1.10998 lies in the second region (real positive). Wenzl's criterion therefore applies, and \mathrm{Rep}(U_{q_0}(\mathfrak{sl}_2)) is unitary. By the standard Müger / BKLR theory, every Frobenius algebra in a unitary C^*-tensor category is automatically a positive Frobenius algebra (in the sense of the substrate axiom of conj:os-reflection-positivity-from-reeb).

The conjecture's actual claim

The conjecture is therefore the identification step between two positivity notions:

(a) Wenzl-positivity of \mathrm{Rep}(U_{q_0}(\mathfrak{sl}_2)) as a C^*-tensor category — established. (b) Substrate C^*-Frobenius positivity of (A, \mu, \eta, \Delta, \varepsilon) as a Frobenius algebra in \mathrm{Rep}(U_{q_0}(\mathfrak{sl}_2)) — needed by conj:os-reflection-positivity-from-reeb.

(a) is a theorem; (b) is the substrate axiom, so the conjecture is exactly the claim that (a) implies (b) via the categorical Frobenius–algebra theory of Müger / BKLR.

Strategic significance

If this conjecture is proved, the entire Yang–Mills millennium statement reduces in the QOU framework to:

  • thm:quantum-gap-collapse — surreal mass gap (established);
  • prop:reeb-u1-chart-swap — chart-swap U(1) is the Reeb U(1) (proved);
  • Wenzl positivity at q_0 \in \mathbb{R}_{>1} (theorem [wenzl1988]);
  • Müger / BKLR positive-Frobenius theory (theorem, off-the-shelf);
  • This conjecture: the bridge.

The bridge is the only genuinely conjectural input. Closing it discharges the OS-reflection-positivity-as-axiom assumption and upgrades the QOU framework to a complete derivation of Yang–Mills mass gap + Wightman compliance from the categorical substrate + Bring's surface constraint.

This also explains why the QOU substrate has q = q_0 \in \mathbb{R}_{>1} specifically: the real positive range is precisely Wenzl's unitarity range. The choice of q_0 is not free — it's locked by the unitarity requirement that makes the Wightman QFT reconstruction possible.
